info.prompt: High-tech reliquary where dice hover like sacred artifacts above a void black altar, their bio-luminescent cores throbbing in sync with a heartbeat monitor overlay. Gothic traceries of gold form a neural network across the UI, framing a slipstream racing HUD that updates position-based beat windows (75ms/100ms/150ms) in real-time. One die remains pocketed—its glowing "Hidden: 5" tag visible only when the player's hand nears the discreet slot, while the rest of the board shudders through a gravity flip with directional arrows flashing RIGHT before tiles snap into new alignment.
